relations.text: Corningは、Amazonのデータセンター向けに光ファイバー、ケーブル、接続製品を供給する複数年の契約が発表された
relations.text_en: Amazon announced a multiyear agreement under which Corning will supply optical fiber, cable and connectivity solutions for its data center infrastructure

source.label: Corning 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Amazon announced a multiyear, multibillion-dollar agreement under which Corning will supply the optical fiber, cable, and connectivity solutions that power Amazon's expanding data center infrastructure across the United States.

relations.text: Corningは、AmazonやNVIDIAなどとの長期的な顧客提携を深めている
relations.text_en: Corning continues to deepen its long-term customer partnerships, most recently with Amazon and NVIDIA

source.label: Corning 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: Weeks continued, “We continue to deepen our long-term customer partnerships with industry leaders, most recently with Amazon and NVIDIA.

relations.text: NVIDIAとCorningは長期提携を発表し、Corningは米国の光接続の製造能力を10倍、光ファイバーの生産能力を50%超拡大する
relations.text_en: NVIDIA and Corning announced a long-term partnership in which Corning will expand U.S. optical connectivity manufacturing capacity by 10x and U.S. fiber production capacity by more than 50%

source.label: Corning 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • NVIDIA and Corning announced a long-term partnership in which Corning will expand its U.S.-based optical connectivity manufacturing capacity by 10x and expand its U.S. fiber production capacity by more than 50% to meet the accelerating demand driven by AI factory buildouts.

relations.text: CorningはAppleと協力し、iPhone 15とiPhone 15 Plusの背面向けに色を染み込ませた耐久性ガラスを提供した
relations.text_en: Corning collaborated with Apple to deliver durable glass with infused color for the back of the iPhone 15 and iPhone 15 Plus

source.label: Corning 10-K
source.quote: We collaborated with Apple to deliver durable glass with infused color for the back of Apple’s iPhone 15 and iPhone 15 Plus devices.
